icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square raster smartphone app icon for a cute bright cozy fairy-village game. Straight-on flat 2D view. Consistent friendly rounded illustration, crisp clean edges, large readable shapes, pastel flat fills, restrained warm brown fine outlines, minimal simple cel shadow, no noisy texture, no gradients, no glossy 3D. One rounded-square colored tile occupies exactly 88% of the square canvas width and height, centered, corner radius about 22% of tile width. Main emblem fits inside central 60% of tile. Outside tile genuinely transparent. No text, letters, labels, phone mockup, extra icons, watermark or outer drop shadow. Intended to display at 80px against plain cream #fff5e4 inside a black phone frame. Subject: A mint-green rounded square tile with one simple ivory three-bar rising chart and a single small green leaf accent; no coins, no currency marks.
